title: The best photographer in Barcelona
text:
I’ve known Cathy for five years and every year I do one or two photo sessions with her.

She's a brilliant photographer, a rare find. She has a talent of capturing your real beauty, your personality in a very elegant and flattering way. 

The best thing I like about her photos is that I look totally like myself, but the best version of myself.

She can capture a variety of moods, moments, personal states. Her photos are vibrant and filled with life. She is also a very good person, very comfortable to work with.
